description: Search public ABOS aircraft listings by natural-language or keyword query. Returns deterministic results after intent interpretation — no black-box ranking.

query.description: e.g. 'Cessna 172 under 200000' or a registration number

notes: This descriptor documents the tool per Appendix F of ABOS_Platform_Specification_v1.0. There is no MCP server exposing it yet — the runtime (base44/functions/abosCoreApiV1) exists and is tested, but calling it requires the API gateway (not deployed) or a trusted server-side caller with ABOS_GATEWAY_SHARED_SECRET. See sdk/js/abosCoreApiClient.mjs.
